query: ALTER TABLE audit_log ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_pkey PRIMARY KEY(id), ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_workspace_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspace(id), ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_resource_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES resource(id), ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_login_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY(login_id) REFERENCES user_login(login_id);
